capabilities: Sync a vault between desktop, iOS and Android through a self-hosted server
Encrypt notes and file names end-to-end with AES-256-GCM before they leave the device
Surface same-line edit conflicts and ask the user, naming the device each side came from
Restore deleted files from any device for thirty days
Set up new devices by QR code with per-device revocable tokens
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns that the vault passphrase is permanent and unrecoverable, and warns readers to check the bind mount in the provided docker-compose.yml before running it. A community guide covers setup on a Ugreen NAS (UGOS).
intentEvidence: If you have looked at Obsidian Sync, Remotely Save, Self-hosted LiveSync, Syncthing or Git
motivation: The author found that every self-hosted sync asks for something first (CouchDB, Docker, Cloudflare, cloud storage) and wanted one small binary on a machine the user already has.
problem: Obsidian's official Sync is a paid subscription, and other self-hosted sync options require cloud storage, CouchDB, Docker, or a Cloudflare account.
